description: This Python script implements a comprehensive subtitle correction and alignment module, capable of aligning subtitle cues to a Whisper-like transcript, correcting timing and text discrepancies, handling missing cues, enforcing OTT timing constraints, and integrating optional audio embeddings for disambiguation. It includes functions for text normalization, language detection heuristics, cue normalization, similarity scoring, complex window search and refinement algorithms, and post-processing of cues into the SRT format. The code is designed for use within a larger subtitle processing pipeline and emphasizes encapsulation, pure functions, and configurability.
